presentation.label: DIGIHEALTH
presentation.summary: FAST AUDIO lowers the DSP load; SYSTEM INFO shows CPU, DSP and memory in the top bar.
presentation.overview: Two SETTINGS rows. FAST AUDIO (on by default) runs the audio render’s hot code from the free on-chip SRAM: the same code, so the audio is identical and the DSP load lower; a watchdog goes back to the stock code if the copy is ever overwritten. SYSTEM INFO shows CPU, DSP, RAM and free sample memory in the top bar, and a read-only USB diagnostics channel (SysEx device 0x7D) answers its desktop tool.
highlights: FAST AUDIO: the render’s hot code runs from on-chip SRAM for a lower DSP load.
A watchdog falls back to the stock code if the copy is overwritten.
SYSTEM INFO: CPU, DSP, RAM and free sample memory in the top bar.
usage: Turn FAST AUDIO on to make room for heavier machines such as SOPHIE.
Watch DSP peaks with SYSTEM INFO while building a pattern.

steps: Tick FAST AUDIO or SYSTEM INFO.

controls.name: FAST AUDIO
controls.doc: Runs the render from SRAM; untick to stop until the next power-on

controls.name: SYSTEM INFO
controls.doc: Shows CPU, DSP and memory in the top bar

limitations: FAST AUDIO’s call-site stubs are derived from the owner’s stock OS file. Modwerk generates them during the local build, never in CI.

load.conditions: Measure with every track playing, parameters modulated and the mod at its heaviest setting.
